desc: Parse N and the binary string A, handling whitespace.
Initialize leaf cost arrays: cost1[i] = 1 if A[i]=='0' else 0; cost0[i] = 1 if A[i]=='1' else 0.
Compute the original root value by iteratively applying majority to the original bits level by level.
Perform bottom-up DP: group the cost arrays in triples and compute parent cost1 = sum of two smallest child cost1, parent cost0 = sum of two smallest child cost0, until one node remains.
Output root cost0 if original root is 1, else root cost1.
Select the one-state monotonicity DP as the correct approach (O(3^N) time, simple and efficient).
Verify solution passes all public samples (N=2 "010011101" -> 1; N=1 "000" -> 2).
